name: – Niclas Herbst – After § 13 – Am 5
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section III – Commission, executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 13 a. Calls on the Commission to establish a temporary European financial instrument, modelled on the SURE mechanism, to support the automotive sector and its supply chain in addressing current structural challenges; recalls that a SURE-like instrument would aim to preserve employment, sustain industrial capacity and promote resilience in the Union’s internal market; considers that the legal basis for such an instrument should be Article 122(2) TFEU, allowing for temporary Union financial assistance in exceptional circumstances; stresses that the proposed support should be subject to appropriate reporting, audit and accountability requirements and should contribute to the Union’s objectives in terms of social cohesion, industrial competitiveness and environmental sustainability;
